analysis.contrarian: WHAT EVERYONE IS FOCUSED ON: Hormuz deadline, oil prices, defense stocks, and the Iran ceasefire binary. The entire market is positioned for the war trade — long energy, long defense, short travel. WHAT IS BEING MISSED: (1) NVO at $36.98 is down 43% in a year and HELD UP on LLY's Foundayo approval — the oral Wegovy cross-trial data could trigger a massive reversion rally if it shows superiority. The market has completely written off NVO but the GLP-1 market is big enough for two winners. (2) The CPI print on Friday April 10 is the REAL macro trade this week — if it comes in hot (>2.6%), the entire rate cut narrative collapses and rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, growth tech, utilities) get crushed. If it comes in cool (<2.3%), the 'one cut in 2026' forecast gets repriced higher and tech/growth rallies. Everyone is watching Hormuz but CPI is the higher-probability market mover. (3) CVX at $198.97 is 7% ABOVE its consensus analyst target of $186.50 — it is one of the most consensus-overextended large-caps in the market. A ceasefire doesn't just mean CVX pulls back — it means it crashes through analyst targets to the downside. (4) The ISM Prices Paid surge to 78.3 is being underappreciated — this is the strongest inflationary signal in manufacturing since the post-COVID era and foreshadows a hot CPI.
riskEvents: Trump Hormuz deadline TOMORROW (April 7, 8pm ET) — Iran reopen Strait or face 'widespread destruction of infrastructure'. Binary outcome for oil ($90 vs $115+), energy stocks, and global risk sentiment.
CPI Release Friday April 10 at 8:30am ET — First reading fully capturing Iran war energy shock. February was 2.4% YoY. If March >2.6%, rate cut expectations collapse; if <2.3%, dovish repricing.

Iran ceasefire proposal rejection — Iran says no direct talks during attacks. If 45-day ceasefire collapses entirely, escalation to infrastructure destruction raises oil to $115+ and triggers global recession fears.
Russian oil waiver expiry April 11 — If Treasury does not renew OFAC general license for 19M barrels on 30 Russia-connected tankers, oil supply tightens further.
NFLX earnings April 16 — Subscriber growth guidance cut 46% YoY. Miss could send stock back below $90 after Goldman upgrade gap.

Negative gamma amplification — Dealer gamma negative with VIX at 24.75 means any directional move gets amplified. A Hormuz escalation + negative gamma could create a 3-5% S&P move in a single session.
Breadth divergence resolution — S&P up 3.6% 5d but only 48.31% above 200 DMA. Narrow leadership typically resolves to the downside when breadth fails to confirm.
Lebanon war expansion — Israeli offensive displaced 800K people, 680 killed. Further regional escalation could cascade into broader Middle East conflict.
